name: service-port
description: Skills, guard hooks and scripts for porting a service 1:1 to another runtime (e.g. Node to .NET) behind a recorded contract suite, and deploying it safely.

deployBranchPattern.title: Deploy branch pattern
deployBranchPattern.description: Regular expression for branches whose push or PR deploys (e.g. ^publish-). Pushing or opening a PR to them needs explicit confirmation.

configEnvPrefix.title: Config env prefix
configEnvPrefix.description: Prefix of environment variables that carry JSON config overrides (e.g. CFG_). Passing them through a shell is blocked.
